hero: A local repair garage interior: an SUV on a lift, a parts shelf with boxes, a creeper and a floor jack; through a high window, Charlevoix mountains and the St. Lawrence in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#1c3833), accent highlights (#ff272c), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers.
